2607.25718.title: Tools Are Not Islands: Set-Level Tool Retrieval for LLM Agents via Query-Conditioned Hyperedge Prediction
2607.25718.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on invoking external tools to complete real-world tasks. Tool retrieval, which selects a small task-relevant subset from a library of thousands of tools before the agent acts, has therefore become a critical component of LLM agent pipelines. However, existing retrievers either score each tool in isolation or assemble the tool set sequentially, so the joint utility of a candidate set is never evaluated as a whole. In this paper, we propose HYSET, short for HYperedge-based SEt-level Tool retrieval. Our contributions are threefold: (i) we formulate tool retrieval as query-conditioned hyperedge prediction on a tool co-invocation hypergraph, under which the tool set itself becomes the unit of scoring and most existing retrieval paradigms reduce to restricted instances; (ii) we capture size-dependent tool compatibility through cardinality-specific interactions; and (iii) we design HYSET as a pre-selection module requiring no modification to the downstream agent. Experiments on ToolBench demonstrate that HYSET consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both tool retrieval performance and end-to-end task success. Beyond the in-domain setting, HYSET further supports zero-shot/few-shot transfer, generalizing to held-out tools/categories and unseen domains with minimal supervision.
2607.25718.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型 (LLM) 代理越來越依賴調用外部工具來完成現實世界的任務。<lb/>因此，工具檢索成為 LLM 代理管道中的一個關鍵組成部分，它從數千個工具的庫中選擇一小部分與任務相關的工具，然後代理才會行動。<lb/>然而，現有的檢索器要麼孤立地評分每個工具，要麼按順序組合工具集，因此候選集的整體效用從未作為一個整體進行評估。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了 HYSET，代表基於超邊的集合級工具檢索。<lb/>我們的貢獻有三個方面： (i) 我們將工具檢索形式化為基於查詢的超邊預測，該預測在工具共同調用的超圖上進行，在這種情況下，工具集本身成為評分的單位，大多數現有的檢索範式簡化為受限實例；<lb/> (ii) 我們通過基數特定的交互捕捉大小依賴的工具兼容性；<lb/> (iii) 我們將 HYSET 設計為一個預選模塊，無需對下游代理進行修改。<lb/>在 ToolBench 上的實驗表明，HYSET 在工具檢索性能和端到端任務成功方面始終超越最先進的基準。<lb/>除了在域內設置之外，HYSET 還進一步支持零樣本/少樣本轉移，能夠在最小監督下泛化到保留的工具/類別和未見的領域。
